title: Elasticity estimation via the CKLS--CIR transform for small-noise CEV-type diffusions
summary: We construct a feasible two-step estimator for the elasticity parameter in small-noise CEV-type diffusions. Under joint small-noise and high-frequency asymptotics, we establish its consistency and an $\varepsilon^{-1}$ central limit theorem with an explicit asymptotic variance. We adapt a Lamperti-based transformation strategy to elasticity inference for a CEV process with an attainable, absorbing $0$ boundary.
